hook: Police came at night to **arrest a woman** in my family.
hook_q: Can a woman be arrested at night?

slides.title: Generally, **no.**
slides.body: Except in exceptional circumstances, no woman shall be arrested after sunset and before sunrise.

slides.title: Exceptional case? **Prior permission** needed.
slides.body: A woman police officer must make a written report and get prior permission from a Magistrate of the first class where the offence was committed or the arrest is to be made.

slides.title: A male officer **shouldn't touch her.**
slides.body: Her submission to custody on being told orally of the arrest is presumed. Unless circumstances otherwise require, or the officer is a woman, the officer shall not touch her to arrest her.

slides.title: Only women can **search a woman.**
slides.body: When a woman has to be searched, the search must be made by another woman, with strict regard to decency.

slides.title: Medical exam by a **woman doctor.**
slides.body: If the arrested person is a woman, her body must be examined only by, or under the supervision of, a female medical officer or, if none is available, a female registered medical practitioner.

slides.title: All the usual **arrest rights** apply too.
list: Arrested without a warrant? Told the grounds at once
A relative, friend or person she names is informed
Can meet an advocate during questioning
A woman who has to file or defend a case gets free legal services

sources: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 – Sections 38, 43, 47, 48, 49, 51, 53 (indiacode.nic.in; NCRB, ncrb.mha.gov.in)
caption:
Can the police arrest a woman at night? Here's what the law says. 👇

1️⃣ Except in exceptional circumstances, no woman shall be arrested between sunset and sunrise
2️⃣ In an exceptional case, a woman police officer must make a written report and get a first-class Magistrate's prior permission
3️⃣ Unless circumstances require it, a male officer shall not touch a woman to arrest her
4️⃣ A woman can only be searched by another woman, with strict regard to decency
5️⃣ Her medical examination must be by, or supervised by, a woman doctor

Source: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 – Sections 38, 43, 47, 48, 49, 51, 53; Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 – Section 12
